newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Rotary to set up design centre in India.
newsitem.headline: Rotary to set up design centre in India.

text.p: Rotary Engineering Ltd said on Thursday it plans to set up an engineering design centre in India and also to buy an office there for about Singapore $1.4 million to house the centre.
The proposed centre at Bangalore's Information Technology Park would provide engineering design services in Asia, the company said in a statement.

The purchase would be financed by internal resources and was not expected to have any significant effect on the company's net tangible asset and earnings per share for the financial year ending December 31.
